The '''Tainted Valley''' was a valley on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tainted Valley appears on Quesh in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
